title: Discrete Gauging of 5d $\mathcal{N}=1$ $E_n$ SCFTs
summary: We study the gauging of discrete symmetries of the 5d rank-one $E_n$ SCFTs that fix the Coulomb branch coordinate but act nontrivially on the Higgs branch chiral ring. Using generalized toric polygons and $(p,q)$-brane webs, we identify symmetries of the moduli space that extend to symmetries of the full SCFT. In many cases they are non-anomalous, and we analyze the moduli space of the gauged theories.
